rounds.text: One Mobikwik Systems Ltd presents a precarious investment profile defined by extreme valuation premiums and persistent operational inefficiency. The company trades at a P/E of 645x [E1] and an EV/EBITDA of 50.25x, both of which vastly exceed sector benchmarks [E6, E11]. This valuation is fundamentally unsupported by the company’s underlying performance, as evidenced by a negative ROE of -8.64% and a negative ROCE of -2.33% [E9, E10]. Furthermore, the firm is currently burning cash, with operating and free cash flows of Rs -78 Cr and Rs -89 Cr respectively [E29, E30]. Institutional confidence appears to be waning, as evidenced by a significant reduction in domestic institutional holdings from 8.85% to 3.52% and a net negative money flow [E38, E39]. Conceded: the company has demonstrated recent improvements in quarterly operating margins and strong compounded sales growth over the last five years [E14, E25]. Despite these isolated metrics, the stock’s high annualised volatility of 59.9% and negative Sharpe ratio of -0.35 highlight the substantial risk inherent in the current price [E46, E47].
